record.one_liner: Ecommerce platform offering store catalog, orders, customers and storefront REST and GraphQL APIs
record.auth_notes: API accounts (store-level, app-level, account-level) are OAuth-based credentials; store-level access token is sent as X-Auth-Token (api_key); apps use an OAuth 2.0 install flow (oauth2); app-level client ID/secret also decode a JWT for Current Customer (other). critic: added oauth2, docs describe OAuth-based API accounts and app OAuth callback flow.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed self_serve_trial. Pricing page offers only a free trial, no free plan; API accounts are created in the store control panel of a trial or paid store.
record.api_notes: Separate REST Admin API, Storefront GraphQL API and Storefront REST API, plus B2B Edition REST API on api-b2b.bigcommerce.com.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready confirmed. Self-serve store-level API accounts and documented REST API. Official Store Management MCP (https://api.bigcommerce.com/mcp) is early access but available to all stores.
